title: Cover the brake
note: Named-spot still for IV-001 line 3. Not a scored card. This JSON is the sole brief authority for the brake footwell. Pedal box matches the locked Encore footwell plate (encore-footwell take 6 / refs/ref_encore_footwell.png): pedal_count 2 only. Posture is one ready-to-press motion: bent knee, thigh down, shin ~45°, heel planted under the pad's lower edge, ankle flexed, ball hovering with visible daylight — not resting on the pad. Winner: cards/takes/IV-001-brake-take-81.png (Claude muted-read PASS, PR #51). Seeded live: cards/IV-001-brake.png (byte-identical master) and public/game/ride/IV-001/brake.webp (encode-still.py). Take-57 was the composite base; only the leg and ankle changed.
hook: Foot off the gas. Heel down under the pad. Ball hovering over the brake, ready to press.
scene: Encore ride-along. Yuna drives. Ali sits the welded rear bench, out of this frame. Cover the brake before the light even thinks about yellow. Foot off the gas. Held. Not riding it.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is low in the left-hand-drive driver footwell of Encore, near the empty floor left of the brake, looking down and slightly forward at the pedal box. EXACTLY TWO pedals occupy the lower-middle of the FRAME, matching the locked footwell plate: wide diamond-treadplate BRAKE on the left of the pair, narrow ribbed ACCELERATOR on the right. Empty painted floor to the LEFT of the brake — no clutch, no third pedal. The brake pedal is the center of the FRAME. Intact windshield with rain-on-glass and overcast wiper-path lighting occupy only the top fifth of the FRAME, soft and out of focus. Analog cluster and one guarded red switch match the Y4 take 1 cockpit lock for cabin language only. That cockpit plate is over-the-wheel; footwell is out of frame there — do not invent pedals from it. No faces.
image_brief.subject: ONE ready-to-press motion of a right leg in a black high-top over the BRAKE — not two separate constraints. Knee bent. Thigh angled down from the seat. Shin dropping about 45 degrees toward the painted floor. Heel planted on the painted floor directly below the brake pad's lower edge. Ankle flexed so the ball of the foot hovers over the wide diamond-treadplate with visible daylight between sole and pad — ready to press, not touching. The sole does not rest on the pad. The foot does not cover or press the pad. The shin is not horizontal. The leg is not straight. Empty painted floor left of the brake stays empty. Gas right of the brake is empty.
image_brief.foreground: exactly two worn pedals from the locked plate — wide diamond-treadplate brake, narrow ribbed accelerator; painted dark Encore floor; the planted heel sitting on the floor under the hanging brake pad; a roll-cage tube at the left edge of the FRAME. No floor mat. No Menace pink mat.

image_brief.background: soft rain-dotted intact windshield and the locked analog dash from Y4 take 1; overcast wiper-path light through glass; a distant traffic light, no readable sign legend
